Overview

What is Raverly?

Its a website and online database full of knitting and crochet patterns, where users can post patterns, buy patterns, and then comment, favorite, and rate those patterns.

What am I collecting?

Using the Ravlery API i am collecting pattern level data including pattern id, type of pattern( knitting or crochet), yarn, yardage, price, ratings, difficulty, number of favorites, and projects made.

Goal

The goal of collecting this data is to ultimately predict what makes a pattern popular and the difference between knitting and crochet patterns.

Movtivation

I love knitting and crocheting and someday when I have lots of free time I would love to develop and post patterns on Ravlery. So this project can help future me and current sellers know what makes a pattern popular/ successful and what kind of projects get the most engagement to focus on what to sell.

Objectives

  • Build a dataset by collecting at least 30,000 patterns and subsets for crochet and knitting

  • Find natural pattern types by clustering by features

  • Explain popularity through modeling

  • Compare knitting and crochet on difficulty yardage, price, and other factors

Methods

Data

All data comes from the Ravelry_API. I used read only credentials meaning I could only access public pattern data. I requested pattern details from the ‘/patterns.json’ endpoint. I stored by credentials in my .env file and made sure to put it in the .gitignore.

Sampling

Every pattern has a id and when you collect through Ravlerys search it returns the top patterns and since i’m analyzing popularity i need a range of patterns not just the most popular. So instead I randomly selected id’s for each batch and requested specific pattern id’s.

Saving Data

patterns were saved on one per line after each batch so a crash or error would lose at most one batch.

import json
import os
import random
import time
import requests

from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import find_dotenv, load_dotenv
API_BASE = "https://api.ravelry.com"

RAW_DIR = Path("../../data/raw-data")
RAW_PATH = RAW_DIR / "ravelry_patterns.jsonl"
MANIFEST_PATH = RAW_DIR / "ravelry_manifest.json"

TARGET_N = 30000           
BATCH_SIZE = 50          
PAUSE_SECONDS = 1.0      
MAX_RETRIES = 5
SEED = 5000
MAX_ID = 1_500_000  

DROP_FIELDS = ("photos", "notes_html")
RETRY_STATUSES = {429, 500, 502, 503, 504}
def make_session():
    load_dotenv(find_dotenv(usecwd=True))
    username = os.getenv("RAVELRY_USERNAME")
    password = os.getenv("RAVELRY_PASSWORD")

    if not username or not password:
        raise RuntimeError("username or password not set. pls set in env")
    session = requests.session()
    session.auth = (username,password)
    session.headers["User-Agent"] = "DSAN 5000 student project (Georgetown University)"
    return session
def get_json(session, path, params):
    for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES):
        response = session.get(f"{API_BASE}{path}", params=params, timeout=30)
        if response.status_code in RETRY_STATUSES:
            time.sleep(PAUSE_SECONDS * 2 **(attempt +1))
            continue
        if response.status_code == 404:
            return None
        response.raise_for_status()
        time.sleep(PAUSE_SECONDS)
        return response.json()
    raise RuntimeError(f"Gave up on {path} after {MAX_RETRIES} retries")
def save_manifest(manifest: dict) -> None:
    RAW_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    MANIFEST_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))

def load_or_create_manifest():
    if MANIFEST_PATH.exists():
        return json.loads(MANIFEST_PATH.read_text())
    manifest = {"max_id": MAX_ID, "seed": SEED, "next_index": 0}
    save_manifest(manifest)
    return manifest

def shuffled_ids(max_id: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    ids = list(range(1, max_id + 1))
    random.Random(seed).shuffle(ids)
    return ids
def fetch_patterns(session, ids):
    if not ids:
        return []
    data = get_json(session, "/patterns.json", {"ids": " ".join(map(str, ids))})
    if data is not None:
        return [p for p in data.get("patterns", {}).values() if p]
    if len(ids) == 1:
        return []
    mid = len(ids) // 2
    return fetch_patterns(session, ids[:mid]) + fetch_patterns(session, ids[mid:])
def trim_record(pattern: dict) -> dict:
    return {k: v for k, v in pattern.items() if k not in DROP_FIELDS}


def append_records(records: list[dict]) -> None:
    with RAW_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for record in records:
            f.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")


def count_saved() -> int:
    if not RAW_PATH.exists():
        return 0
    with RAW_PATH.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return sum(1 for _ in f)
def collect(session: requests.Session) -> None:
    manifest = load_or_create_manifest()
    candidates = shuffled_ids(manifest["max_id"], manifest["seed"])
    saved = count_saved()
    start = time.time()

    while saved < TARGET_N and manifest["next_index"] < len(candidates):
        i = manifest["next_index"]
        batch = candidates[i : i + BATCH_SIZE]
        records = [trim_record(p) for p in fetch_patterns(session, batch)]
        append_records(records)
        saved += len(records)
        manifest["next_index"] = i + len(batch)
        save_manifest(manifest)

        if (i // BATCH_SIZE) % 20 == 0:
            hit_rate = saved / max(manifest["next_index"], 1)
            print(f"{saved:,}/{TARGET_N:,} saved | {manifest['next_index']:,} IDs tried "
                  f"| hit rate {hit_rate:.0%} | {(time.time() - start) / 60:.1f} min")

    print(f"Done: {saved:,} patterns in {RAW_PATH}")


session = make_session()
collect(session)

def summarize_raw() -> None:
    crafts, free, sample = {}, 0, None
    with RAW_PATH.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for n, line in enumerate(f, start=1):
            p = json.loads(line)
            craft = (p.get("craft") or {}).get("name", "Unknown")
            crafts[craft] = crafts.get(craft, 0) + 1
            free += bool(p.get("free"))
            sample = sample or p
    print(f"{n:,} patterns | {free / n:.0%} free")
    print("By craft:", dict(sorted(crafts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])))
    print("Fields available:", sorted(sample.keys()))

Challenges

  • API Access : I accidentally posting my username and password to my public git and took it down shortly after however the newly generate username ans password didn’t work so I had to use the leaked version.
  • Missing ID’s : About 16% of ids belong to deleted or private patterns and most batch’s of 50 at least one.
  • Collection Time : Took a very long time to collect all 30,000 postings but relatively straight forward collection process

Benchmarks

  • There had been other projects done using the Ravlery API. Including another DSAN 5000 project however my goals and objects differ from any work i can find currently. First the way I am gathering random id’s and having lots of variation in patterns as the other pattern top only top ranked patterns. Seconf the goals are completely different i am looking at popularity and factors that go into it and they tried to identify pattern type.
